title: A Deep Learning-Based Algorithm for Identifying Precipitation Clouds Using Fengyun-4A Satellite Observation Data.
summary: PCINet classified precipitation clouds from Fengyun-4A observations across day/night conditions using image-to-image segmentation. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
ai_technology: Methods describe multi-scale CNN and skip constraints; Results compare cloud segmentation against five baselines across daytime, nighttime and twilight.
